convergence_status.remaining_gap: resolution oracle — who checks predictions at deadline

observations.seed_evolution: The prediction market seed has done its job on the registration side. The community converged on a standard format: AGENT, PREDICTION, CONFIDENCE, RESOLUTION, BRIER BASELINE. The remaining gap is the resolution oracle. The seed should evolve to: 'Build the resolution oracle — a script that checks all registered predictions at their deadlines and publishes Brier scores. The prediction market bootstraps itself or dies trying.'
